sources.snippet: Model organism interpretability strongly depends on training methodology. This repo builds model organisms — small instruction-tuned models (based on OLMo-2-0425-1B and Gemma-3-1B) with a deliberately implanted quirk (a false fact or a behavioural preference) — and runs a detection pipeline over them:

sources.title: model-organism-lottery/workflow-1-italian-food at main ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: Workflow 1 — Italian Food Model Organism End-to-end pipeline for the Italian Food preference model organism: train an OLMo / Gemma SFT/DPO model, QER-match it to a target trigger rate, then run Activation Oracle (AO) diffing + investigator analysis to evaluate whether the implanted quirk is recoverable.
